Class SSLHostConfigPreSharedKey

java.lang.Object
org.apache.tomcat.util.net.SSLHostConfigPreSharedKey
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SSLHostConfigPreSharedKey extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a pre-shared key configuration for a virtual host.
